events.text: Herod the Great rules for Rome and rebuilds the temple.
Jesus is crucified and rises (about AD 30).
The temple still stands, with its priests and sacrifices; the church spreads.
Revolt against Rome from AD 66; the temple destroyed in AD 70.
Nero is emperor from AD 54; the fire of Rome in AD 64 leads to persecution in the city.
A year of civil war, then Vespasian.
Written probably in the 60s, before the temple fell (debated)

teaser.title: The first believers are tested
teaser.text: Insults, prison, and loss of property (10:32-34).

teaser.title: Hebrews is written
teaser.text: A sermon to a tired community, perhaps in the 60s.

teaser.title: The temple falls
teaser.text: Rome destroys the temple in AD 70, ending the sacrifices the letter describes.

review.note: Hand-written first draft from general knowledge. Check against commentaries and a lexicon.
